# Names and tools: every problem says where it is and how to fix it.
# (from diagnostics_golden)

# a name nobody declared
! exec metagente check undeclared_name.ag
stderr 'Problem on line 5 of undeclared_name\.ag'
stderr 'I do not know what `nme` is here'
stderr 'Fix: '

# a built in tool used without `tool file`
! exec metagente check undeclared_tool.ag
stderr 'never declared it'
stderr 'tool file'
stderr 'Found 1 problem\.'

# a wrong parameter name: both the missing value and the stray one are reported
! exec metagente check bad_param.ag
stderr 'needs a value for `path`'
stderr 'does not take `pth`'
stderr 'did you mean `path`\?'
stderr 'Found 2 problems\.'

# a mistyped action
! exec metagente check unknown_action.ag
stderr 'did you mean `file\.read`\?'
stderr '`file` can do: read, write'

-- undeclared_name.ag --
agent A
  goal "x"
  accepts go
  on go
    reply nme
-- undeclared_tool.ag --
agent A
  goal "x"
  accepts go
  on go
    x = file.read path: "a"
    reply x
-- bad_param.ag --
agent A
  goal "x"
  tool file
  accepts go
  on go
    x = file.read pth: "a"
    reply x
-- unknown_action.ag --
agent A
  goal "x"
  tool file
  accepts go
  on go
    x = file.reed path: "a"
    reply x
